# Job Description – Graduate Biotechnology Associate (Pharmaceutical Company, Scotland)

## Position

Graduate Biotechnology Associate

## Location

Scotland, United Kingdom

## Employment Type

Full-time

### About the Role

We are seeking a motivated Biotechnology graduate to join our pharmaceutical research and manufacturing team. The successful candidate will support laboratory operations, quality assurance activities, and research projects focused on developing safe and effective pharmaceutical products. This role offers excellent opportunities to gain experience in a regulated pharmaceutical environment while working alongside experienced scientists.

### Key Responsibilities

* Perform laboratory experiments following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Prepare samples for microbiological, biochemical, and molecular analyses.
* Assist in quality control testing of pharmaceutical products.
* Record, analyse, and interpret experimental data accurately.
* Maintain laboratory equipment and ensure proper calibration.
* Support research and development projects for new drug formulations.
* Follow Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and health & safety regulations.
* Prepare technical reports and maintain accurate laboratory documentation.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Quality Assurance, Production, and Regulatory Affairs.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to optimise laboratory processes.

### Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, Microbiology, Biochemistry, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of molecular biology, microbiology, and laboratory techniques.
* Knowledge of GLP, GMP, and pharmaceutical regulations.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams.

### Preferred Skills

* Experience with PCR, ELISA, HPLC, GC-MS, or spectrophotometry.
* Familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS).
* Basic statistical analysis using Excel or scientific software.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical quality assurance processes.
* Previous internship or laboratory research experience.

### Desired Personal Attributes

* Attention to detail.
* Strong organisational skills.
* Adaptability and willingness to learn.
* Professional ethics and integrity.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks under deadlines.

### Benefits

* Competitive salary.
* Annual performance bonus.
* Pension scheme.
* Private healthcare.
* Paid annual leave.
* Professional development and training.
* Career progression opportunities within research and manufacturing.
